WITH city_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    zc.city,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) as member_count
  FROM attendance a
  JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
  JOIN zip_code zc ON m.zip = zc.zip_code
  GROUP BY zc.city
),
total_members AS (
  SELECT SUM(member_count) as total FROM city_counts
),
city_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    cc.city,
    cc.member_count,
    CAST(cc.member_count AS REAL) / tm.total as share
  FROM city_counts cc
  CROSS JOIN total_members tm
),
average_share_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM city_shares
),
above_average_cities AS (
  SELECT 
    cs.city,
    cs.member_count,
    cs.share,
    (cs.share - asc.avg_share) as above_avg
  FROM city_shares cs
  CROSS JOIN average_share_calc asc
  WHERE cs.share > asc.avg_share
)
SELECT 
  AVG(member_count) as avg_count,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(above_avg) as avg_above_average
FROM above_average_cities
